# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest version of WP User Manager only. If you're reporting an issue, please check that it reproduces on the [current release](https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-user-manager/).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report security issues in public GitHub issues or on the WordPress.org support forum.

Report them through the [Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program](https://patchstack.com/database/vdp/wp-user-manager/). The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify us.

If Patchstack declines your report, or you'd rather contact us directly, email support@wpusermanager.com with "Security" in the subject. Messages sent there are private to our team.

Please include:

- the version you reproduced it on, and any addons that were active
- the affected file, function or endpoint
- the prerequisites: the user role needed, and any non-default settings or plugins
- steps to reproduce, and a proof of concept if you have one
- the impact you believe it has

## What happens next

We'll confirm we've received your report, reproduce it, and keep you updated while we work on a fix. Once the fix is released we'll credit you in the changelog, unless you'd rather not be named.
